message.loading_protection.ended_movemen: Loading Protection ended because you moved.
screen.loading_protection.missing_yacl.t: YACL is required for this config screen
screen.loading_protection.missing_yacl.b: Install Yet Another Config Lib v3 on the client to edit Loading Protection in-game. Server owners can still edit config/loadingprotection-common.toml manually.
yacl3.config.loading_protection:option.p: Maximum number of seconds the player stays protected after the trigger fires.
yacl3.config.loading_protection:option.e: Ends protection as soon as the player actually changes position. Looking around does not count.
yacl3.config.loading_protection:option.p: Also protects the vehicle currently ridden by a protected player.
Continuously clears hostile mob targets while protection is active.
Protected players cannot damage players or mobs until protection ends.
yacl3.config.loading_protection:option.t: Applies protection when a player joins a world or server.
Also applies protection after player respawn.
Also applies protection after cross-dimension travel.
yacl3.config.loading_protection:option.s: Shows start, key countdown, and expiration notices to the affected player only.
yacl3.config.loading_protection:option.m: Choose whether countdown notices appear in chat, in the action bar, or in both places.
